{{Weapon infobox | type = Warhorn | level = 80 | salvage = none | uslot = Superior Sigil of Accuracy | rarity = Legendary | prefix = selectable | bound = account use | skin = Howler (skin); Howl (skin); Windstorm (skin); Howl Experiment (skin) | id = 30702 | gallery2 = Howler stowed.jpg | gallery2-text = stowed. | gallery3 = Howler footfalls.jpg | gallery3-text = Watery, foggy footprints. }} [[Howler]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] [[warhorn]] crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. The horn's design resembles a wolf head and a snake, with the wolf head moving and howling during certain animations. Howler is heavily associated with ghosts, shades, and the [[Spirits of the Wild]], especially [[Wolf (Spirit of the Wild)|Wolf]]. [[Howler III: Howl]] == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|A [[norn]] ballad recounts a quarrel between the Great Wolf and a serpent who sought to become a [[Spirit of the Wild]]: O little snake, do you have what it takes? Howl, howl—open the gate.}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Howl | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Howler | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == [[Howler]] is a wolf-headed warhorn with a snake coiling around the body of the horn. ;Aura * When wielded, a cloud of fog follows the player. When standing still, the fog surrounds the wielder. ;Draw/Stow effects * When drawn, a burst of water splashes the user's body, before raining down in small droplets, leaving ripples in the ground. Additionally, a full moon can be briefly seen around the wolf's head, regardless of the time of day. ;Nighttime effects * When wielded during the [[Day and night|night]], a full moon appears in the crescent of the horn, surrounding the wolf's head. * When drawn during the night, the wolf will raise its head and let out a faint howl. The wolf will periodically raise its head, but it will not howl a second time. ;Footfalls * The user leaves behind subtle watery footprints that quickly evaporate into fog. ;Skill effects * Upon blowing the horn, the wolf's head rises and howls, while a moon illuminates in the crescent of the horn for a brief moment. Additionally, a big ghostly wolf head grows briefly from the horn, and mirrors the smaller wolf in the horn in howling. The howl of the ghostly wolf creates an extremely brief foggy breath along with rings from the vibration of its howl. {{anomaly|The fog aura will take a few extra seconds to appear when drawing Howler for the first time after leaving a particle-heavy area, such as Frostgorge Sound.}} === Gallery === File:Howler effect.jpg|Ghost wolf effect when blowing the horn. Crafting]]. |} == Available prefixes == * The following [[Attribute combinations|prefixes]] can be selected: {{prefix selection|all legendary}} == Trivia == * Howler originally featured unique day and night appearances, however, a game patch which was intended to remove an aura stacking exploit and some other nighttime bugs took away this effect. ** Incidentally, Howler's nighttime effects were the result of a bug.[https://www.reddit.com/r/Guildwars2/comments/3vfeu3/letter_of_introduction_and_lets_talk_about/cxn5v77], Reddit post by Matt Pennebaker. *** The missing nighttime effects were restored with the [[Game_updates/2015-12-15|December 15, 2015 game update]]. * Howler might be heavily influenced by Norse mythology, in particular by Loki's children. ** The wolf might represent Fenrir, a very big and fierce wolf. The snake might represent Jormungand, the enormous World Serpent that surrounds the Earth, or Midgard, just like Howler's snake surrounds the horn. And Howler's connection to ghosts and spirits might be a reference to Hel, who takes care of a portion of the dead. [[w:Loki|Loki, in Wikipedia, summarising the ''Poetic Edda'' and the ''Prossa Edda''.]] * Prior to the [[Game updates/2021-07-27|game update of July 27, 2021]], the ghost wolf effect when blowing the horn only worked on a few selected skills, namely: [[Call of the Wild]], [[Charge]], and [[Call of Valor]]. Now it appears with any skill used. == See also == * [[Howler I: The Experimental Warhorn]] * [[Howler II: The Perfected Warhorn]] * [[Howler III: Howl]] == References == {{Legendary weapon nav}} [[Category:Weapons with unique sounds]] [[de:Heuler]] [[es:Aullador]] [[fr:Brame]]
